title: RN app deployment manifest
description: What ONE deployment's app bundle is composed of. The JS bundle is static (Hermes loads no code at runtime), so this manifest is consumed at BUILD time: scripts/gen-deployment.mjs turns it into static imports (src/deployment.generated.ts) that Metro bundles. Select a manifest with MEMEX_DEPLOYMENT=<name|path> (default: deployment/default.json).

portalUrl.description: The mesh a NATIVE build dials by default (web is same-origin). MEMEX_PORTAL_URL still overrides at build time.

displayName.description: The name in the top bar (desktop widths).

accentDark.description: Dark-mode accent (hex); falls back to accent.

modules.description: Client modules composed into the bundle — anything of interest a deployment needs: each entry is a Metro-resolvable import specifier (a package name, or a path relative to the app root) whose module default-exports a DeploymentModule ({ name?, pack?: { controls, skins, fallback, defaultContainer } } — @meshweaver/react/core). Later modules win on collisions.
